payment_period_pair.name: payment_period_pair
payment_period_pair.value: ("payment"."period_start" is null and "payment"."period_end" is null) or ("payment"."period_start" is not null and "payment"."period_end" is not null and "payment"."period_end" > "payment"."period_start")

payment_kind_reference.name: payment_kind_reference
payment_kind_reference.value: ("payment"."kind" = 'one_time' and "payment"."purchase_id" is not null and "payment"."subscription_id" is null) or ("payment"."kind" in ('initial', 'renewal', 'adjustment') and "payment"."subscription_id" is not null and "payment"."purchase_id" is null)
